svg.title: Logical request, physical attempts, and timing clocks
svg.desc: A scheduled logical request waits for a worker and opens a fresh HTTP/1.1 connection for the physical attempt. Immediately before every physical inference POST, a command-local no-wait runtime guard atomically reserves query, token, and exact serialized-byte budget; a denial sends no POST. An accepted attempt starts final-attempt request-path clocks immediately before the request call and consumes an SSE stream. Compatibility, credential, or transport fallback creates another separately admitted POST with another fresh connection. The client retains response model identity and the Databricks served-model-name routed-entity header, and distinguishes reasoning, visible, refusal, tool, usage, and terminal events. Exact caller clocks use the scheduled target. Terminal admission evidence and the completed result are appended to a durable journal.
